title: aurinia saxatilis
intro: Aurinia saxatilis, commonly known as mouse-ear cress, is a flowering plant in the family Brassicaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Aurinia saxatilis include stimulating the secretion of mucus and relieving congestion in the respiratory tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates and glucosinolates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
